scenes.primaryRequest: A colossal spiral cloud vortex rises as an atmospheric crown above a dark coastline, encircled by radar arcs with a red warning pulse.
A towering anvil cloud acts as a stage titan while a branching lightning strike detonates through its core and pressure shockwaves freeze at the climax.
Monumental rain curtains descend through a topographic city diorama while an observation beacon cuts an amber searchlight through the deluge.
A gigantic solar heat halo ignites behind a miniature observatory as thermal mirage rings fracture the air into an incandescent crown.
Visible ribbons of compressed wind spiral around a brass anemometer like an atmospheric beast, freezing leaves and markers in midair.
A copper-red wall of dust advances like a theatrical curtain as a central tower projects pale radar rings into a crown-shaped vortex.
An illuminated mountain cutaway shears and slides at the climax, exposing amber strata while a geology probe projects a pale beam through suspended rock.
